title: Establish Control
caption: Establish Control (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your Force generation is +2 at docking bays you control. Your docking bays controlled by opponent are battlegrounds. Once per game, may ▼ Corulag or Fondor. If Mobilization Points on table, this Effect lost. {alter}
lore: Keeping supply routes clear allows rapid distribution of resources to where they are most required.

Margin credits printed vertically: left 'Original concept by Garrett Larson', right 'Bespin Regionals 2005'. Lore matches the scan.
